minor.issue: list_conversations now runs 4 aggregations + N subscriber-lookups + 1 sidecar /contacts-bulk + 1 update_many per relink on every list. With ~200 phones this is fine, but at scale (>1k) the N+1 link calls inside the for loop will be slow. Consider batching the link lookup via a single subscriber_phones $in query.

issues: Visual is polished and matches FocusChat reference: 46px avatar with WA badge + status dot, bold name, monospaced phone, branch tag with building icon, teal plan tag, gradient assignee pill, direction arrow, green unread badge — all rendering correctly. Only minor nit: search placeholder still reads 'Buscar em automático...' (bucket-scoped) even though the search is GLOBAL when text is entered — could mislead the user. Suggest: 'Buscar em todas as conversas...' or dynamic placeholder.

action_items: (MINOR / OPTIONAL) Update search input placeholder text — currently says 'Buscar em automático...' which conflicts with the new GLOBAL search behavior when text is typed.

(PERF / SCALE) Replace the per-phone link_phone_to_subscriber loop in list_conversations with a single batch query against subscriber_phones to avoid N+1 lookups for tenants with hundreds of conversations.
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppChatLayout.js is now ~1370 lines (ChatThread + ChatCoachingPopup + CustomerProfileModal + ConvRow + helpers all in one file). >700-line rule should trigger a split — recommend /components/whatsapp/ConvRow.js, ChatThread.js, CustomerModal.js, CoachingPopup.js.

list_conversations in whatsapp_baileys.py uses an in-loop dynamic import of link_phone_to_subscriber on every request. Hoist the import to module top now that the function exists permanently — saves one Python import lookup per request.

Retroactive update_many on aihub_wa_messages is fired inside the GET handler. This means every conversations list refresh can write to messages collection. Consider gating with a 5-minute throttle per phone (e.g., store last_relink_attempt in wa_conversations) to avoid hammering the DB.

/contacts-bulk is called inline with timeout=5s on every /conversations request. If sidecar is slow this adds latency to every chat refresh. The try/except swallows errors but the 5s wait still blocks. Consider firing this in background and caching avatars in mongo with TTL.
